verdict.rationale: An email API platform with a dashboard could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no in-product assistant. The Resend MCP server and llms.txt let external AI clients such as Cursor and Claude operate Resend, but that is a different capability from delegating tasks to an assistant built into the product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
